prs.title: Pass initialInsertion when navigating an iframe
prs.author: shannonbooth
prs.body:
Processing the iframe attributes did not pass initialInsertion to
"navigate an iframe or frame", so inserting an iframe whose javascript:
URL src produces no document did not fire a load event, unlike
implementations.

Frames did pass it, but the load event step of "navigate to a
javascript: URL" ran the iframe load event steps, which only apply to
iframe elements. Fire a plain load event at a frame instead.

Follow up to #12978 and #12959

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Firefox (implements)
   * Webkit (implements)
   * Chromium (implements, modulo the linked issue from when initial insertion flag was first introduced)
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/semantics/embedded-content/the-iframe-element/iframe_javascript_url_initial_insertion.html
   * trusted-types/navigate-to-javascript-url-009.html
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/62993
- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/417176295
   * Gecko: N/A
   * WebKit: N/A
- [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A
- [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed
